title: Captain Carson Teva
description: Captain Carson Teva was an X-wing pilot for the New Republic. He and partner Trapper Wolf encountered The Mandalorian, Din Djarin, in his Razor Crest. They chased the ship until it went down on Maldo Kreis. Teva and Wolf rescued Djarin and his passengers from ice spiders. He had another patrol encounter with Djarin in his new N-1 Starfighter
